text:
Type: white two-drawer kids chest
Use: storing children's clothes and toys; children's room, nursery
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: painted fiberboard in a smooth matte finish
Colors: soft off-white, grey grip holes
Shape: two deep drawers with large round cut-out grips, rounded top corners and soft edges, sides that extend into short curved legs, friendly and compact
Feel: soft, gentle, calm, playful
Goes with: pastel walls, pale wood, colorful textiles; Scandinavian or modern children's rooms

product.name: BUSUNGE
product.description: Comes with 2 drawers for a roomy storage space.
